blocks.text: Zir-Arch is the pinnacle of implant-supported prosthetics, offering a state-of-the-art solution for those seeking complete arch replacement. This innovative treatment features monolithic zirconia full-arch bridges, meticulously crafted from a single solid block of zirconia. The result is a set of replacement teeth for either the upper or lower arch that delivers unmatched strength, durability, and aesthetic appeal. With Zir-Arch, you can enjoy a long-lasting, natural-looking smile that enhances both function and appearance.

features.eyebrow: Why Choose Zir-Arch at Younes Dental Clinic?

items.title: Longevity & Durability
items.text: Zir-Arch bridges are made from monolithic zirconia, known for its exceptional strength and resilience. These bridges are engineered to endure the forces of biting and chewing without fracturing or chipping, ensuring long-lasting performance and providing peace of mind.

items.title: Natural Aesthetics & Comfort
items.text: Zirconia closely replicates the natural appearance of teeth, allowing Zir-Arch bridges to blend seamlessly with your smile. Thanks to its high strength and precise implant positioning, Zir-Arch bridges are slim, comfortable, and virtually indistinguishable from natural teeth.

items.title: Biocompatibility & Hygiene
items.text: Zirconia is highly biocompatible, meaning it rarely causes allergic reactions or adverse tissue responses. This makes it a safe and reliable choice for dental restorations. Additionally, its smooth, non-porous surface resists bacterial adhesion, promoting excellent oral hygiene and reducing the risk of plaque buildup and gum disease.

faq.q: What makes Zir-Arch different from other implant-supported prosthetics?
faq.a: Zir-Arch stands out because it is crafted from a single block of monolithic zirconia, which provides superior strength, durability, and aesthetics. Unlike other materials, zirconia is highly resistant to fractures and chips, making it a long-lasting solution. Additionally, its natural appearance and biocompatibility make it an excellent choice for patients seeking a high-quality, realistic-looking prosthetic

faq.q: How long does a Zir-Arch bridge last?
faq.a: With proper care and maintenance, Zir-Arch bridges can last for many years, often 15 years or more. The durability of zirconia combined with regular dental check-ups and good oral hygiene practices ensures that your Zir-Arch bridge remains in excellent condition over the long term.

The Zir-Arch procedure involves placing implants and fitting the bridge, which is typically done under local anesthesia to minimize discomfort. While some patients may experience mild soreness or swelling afterward, this can usually be managed with over-the-counter pain relievers. Most patients find the procedure to be relatively painless, especially compared to the benefits of a restored smile.

faq.q: How do I care for my Zir-Arch bridge?
faq.a: Caring for a Zir-Arch bridge is similar to caring for natural teeth. Regular brushing and flossing are essential to maintain good oral hygiene. It’s also important to visit your dentist regularly for check-ups and professional cleanings to ensure your bridge and implants remain in optimal condition. Avoiding very hard foods and not using your teeth as tools will also help prolong the life of your Zir-Arch bridge.
